_comment: The values the active Astryx theme cannot reach. Everything a React component renders reads semantic tokens and follows the theme by itself; these four places do not, because they are consumed outside React: an HTML <meta> the browser paints its chrome with, a webfont URL, a static manifest, and a social card rendered by a node script. Keeping them here means one theme swap edits one file, not four. Values must match the corresponding tokens in the active theme file.
_fontNote: Butter also names Sarina for display-* text. Nothing in this product renders a display type — Astryx scopes that treatment to the Text component and every hero here is a Heading — so requesting Sarina would ship a face the page never paints. Add it back the moment a display type appears.
